description: Generate situations (nodes) based on the world seed using Alexandrian node-based design. Returns a prompt for LLM execution. Can generate all at once or one at a time using count=1 with focusOn for better parallelism.

count.description: Number of situations to generate (default: from world seed or 5)

focusOn.description: Specific situation seeds to focus on (by name)

name: generate_situations
